name: imagen-a-slide
displayName: Imagen a slide (PPTX editable o HTML)
description: Rebuilds slide images (PNG/JPG/WEBP, PDF or flat PPTX) as editable slides with the same design: a native PowerPoint (desktop PowerPoint on Windows) and/or a single self-contained HTML presentation, from one shared JSON spec. Includes the build engines, local Windows OCR, background-plate cleaning, cropping, a numeric source-vs-render comparison (Podman or local Python, optional), a regression bench, and two subagents (Sonnet spec writer, Haiku visual QA).
